concept: Review and integration: a lifelong stance that your actions matter, as the foundation beneath every other Pillar
source_inspiration: original content — cumulative review, not sourced from any external text

exercise.reflection_prompt: Across ownership of your circumstances, building despite uncertainty, and modeling for others — what's your personal throughline as someone who acts?
exercise.practice: Adult writes a short personal statement on what agency means to them in practice

assessment.success_marker: adult produces a personal statement referencing at least two of the three adult-stage scenarios
